name: app-lobed-circle-problem-solution-diagram-with-red-and-green-segments
title: Lobed Circle Problem and Solution Diagram
whatItIs: A light grey slide titled Problem & Solution with a paragraph, a white sphere-like circle with three lobed segments (two red numbered 01 and 02, one green 03), red and green connector lines to Problem 1 and 2 labels with percentages and a Solution heading and paragraph below.
whatItMeans: A single circle with coloured lobes makes problems and the solution parts of one whole, and red versus green reads instantly.
techniques: Lobed segments on a white circle as an infographic
Red for problems, green for the solution
Thin connector lines to pill labels
Soft shadow and glow around the circle

vocabulary.definition: A rounded tab shape that fits into a circle's edge.
A pill linked by a thin line to a part of a graphic.
Using red and green to signal negative and positive.
